## **Recent changes through a role upgrade proposal:**
New Category: **Lead Community Mod**
Per month incentives for 'Lead Community Mods': 1500 USD

Frogman proposed and approved his role upgrade from the 'Senior Community Mod' role to the 'Lead Community Mod' role.
Know more here: [https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/7000-role-upgrade-proposal-lead-community-moderator](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/7000-role-upgrade-proposal-lead-community-moderator)

## Incentives:

Incentives for Lead Community Mods: 1500 USD equivalent per month for daily 6 hours of moderation, community engagement activities and an additional periodic deliverable {for example: infographics for social media posts}.
Total number of Lead Community Mods: 1

Incentives for Senior Community Mods: 1000 USD equivalent per month for daily 6 hours of moderation and community engagement activities.
Total number of Senior Community Mods: 1

Incentives for Community Mods: 500 USD equivalent per month for daily 6 hours of moderation.
Total number of Community Mods: 2

Incentives for solo Regional Mod: 125 USD per month
Total number of Regional Mods: 5

NSP fee: $0
New total in USD:** $ 4125**
